synthetic_restore_and_recovery_targets.detail: 6 passed. A verified snapshot restored 10/10 baseline synthetic encounters in 0.025862 seconds against a 60-second local RTO target. A post-snapshot record was not present after restore, demonstrating that recovery returns to the last verified snapshot. Modified backup bytes were rejected by integrity verification.

operations_playbook_contract.detail: RTO and snapshot-scoped RPO targets, failure handling, paired database/media recovery, and hardware scope are documented and structurally checked.

limitations: Measurements use a small synthetic SQLite database on this Windows 11 workstation; they do not generalize to production hardware or databases.
No automated backup schedule exists, so the prototype has no bounded wall-clock RPO. The RPO statement applies only to records included in the latest completed hash-verified snapshot.
The 60-second target is an engineering test target, not a production service-level commitment.
